lines: DIRECTOR IN TOWN! DIRECTOR STILL IN TOWN! DIRECTOR —
...she's gone, actually. Went south an hour back and nobody thought to tell me.
I'll keep crying it until somebody official says stop. That's the job.
FOUR ROADS! WEST TO THE QUARRY, SOUTH TO THE COAST, NORTH TO NOTHING!
EAST ROAD STILL CLOSED! THIRTY-ONE YEARS AND COUNTING!
...Sorry. Force of habit. You shout for a living, you stop being able to stop.

tr_drover: Can't get the herd over the Route 3 bridge. Not one animal.
Walked them the long way round instead. Four days, and they went happily.
They know something. Animals always know first and they never say what.

lines: You went in and you came out again. Most people manage one of those.
She'll have been reasonable with you. She's always reasonable.
Nine years I've worked for her and I still can't say if that's a comfort.
Office is open. Ask us whatever you like, we're instructed to answer.
That isn't generosity, it's policy. We have nothing to hide.
And we are very, very tired of being asked.

tr_child: I'm going to be a surveyor.
They get a coat and a brass thing and everyone stops talking when they walk in.
Mum says that isn't a reason. It's a bit of a reason.

lines: You met her, then. Everyone says the same thing afterwards.
That she was reasonable. Always that word. Never once anything else.
I've a letter to carry back to Sorrell and I don't know what to put in it.
You're the one Sorrell sent out? He writes to this office every week.
They keep the letters. Filed, dated, never answered. I've seen the drawer.
Go in and look for yourself. The Director came down herself two days ago.

tr_rester: Walked up from Brackwater. Two days on the coast road and not one gull.
I've made that walk since I was nine. There are always gulls.
You don't notice a sound until you've spent two days listening for it.
tr_shop_hand: Net Vessels are new in. Good on anything that swims.
Which is most of what you'll meet south of here, so don't be clever about it.

lines: The Director spoke to you personally. That doesn't happen.
I've filed everything she said. I've read it back twice since.
It's all correct. Every line. I'd feel better if one bit of it weren't.
Survey office. Soundings, bearings, permits. In that order, please.
No, you may not see the west face readings. Yes, I know how that sounds.
It isn't bad. It's procedure. Those are different, and I'm required to say so.

tr_concord_hand: Nine sites this season and not one of them near the coast.
You'd think a body that worries about the sea might survey the sea.
...I've said too much. I say that a lot lately, and I keep on saying things.

lines: You've been in to see the Kerrow girl. Her brother's name was Ald.
Nobody says it now. They say two hundred and forty, which is worse.
Decide what you like about her. Decide it knowing she isn't pretending.
Eighty-one years at this crossroads and six of them spent indoors.
I remember the last Turning. I was ten. The sea came up the south road to the well.
Everyone talks about stopping it now as though that's a simple thing. It isn't.
But nobody who was there thinks it should be allowed to happen twice.
